in_marathi.name: Antariksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Antariksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Antariksha refers to the sky or space in Hindu mythology. It is the name of the god of the sky and the atmosphere. In Vedic scriptures, Antariksha is also described as the expanse of the universe and the divine breath of the cosmos.
